question: Which of the following Chinese pilgrims visited India about 50 years after Xuan Tsang?
solution:
The correct answer is__** I-king.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **I-king/sing**, also known as **Yijing**, was a Chinese Buddhist monk who **visited India around 50 years after Xuan Tsang.**
 
• He sailed from Canton to **India **in 671 and **arrived **there in **673**. Following his tour of the holy Buddhist sites in Magadha.
 
• He spent **10 years** studying the Vinya at the illustrious **Nalanda monastery (676–685)**.
 
• In 685, he departed from India and went to the then heavily Indianized city of **Shri Bhoja** (or Sri Boja, also called Shri Vijaya, or Palembang in **Sumatra**). Here, he focused on **translating Buddhist scriptures** written in Sanskrit.
 
• **He went back to China in 689** to get help with his translations. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Xuan Tsang/Hyun Tsang or Hiuen-Tsang** was a famous Chinese Buddhist monk who** visited India in the 7th century AD.**

 
 
• He left China in AD** 629 **and traveled via Central Asia via Kucha on the northern trade route to **reach northern India.**
 
• There, in the **city of Kanauj**, he was the guest of the renowned Indian** ruler Harsavardhana.**
 
• His journey lasted for** 17 years**, during which he visited many important Buddhist centers and monasteries.
 
• He **returned **to China in AD **645**.
 
 
 
• **Fahiyan/Fa-hien**, also known as **Faxian**, was another Chinese Buddhist monk who** visited India in the 5th century AD**.
 
 
• He travelled to India during **Chandragupta II’s rule** and composed the** book Fo-kwo-ki **(Travels of Fa-hien).
 
• He was the first Chinese Buddhist pilgrim to leave an account of his travels to Central Asia, India, and Sri Lanka. 
 
• He is known for his detailed account of the Buddhist sites and teachings in India, which he recorded in his** book "A Record of Buddhist Kingdoms."**
 
 
 
• **Tsang Hi** was a **Chinese general** who lived during the **Tang dynasty**, while** Lao Tzu** was a **Chinese philosopher** who lived during the **Zhou dynasty.**
